rom.notes: Final build: Classic DeX, USB debugging from first boot, full storage, faster installer. Earlier builds: back up and use install once for full storage (update keeps 30 GB).

packs.title: Fast charging indicator
packs.description: Shows Fast charging or Super fast charging for fast chargers (33 W PPS = Super fast), and the charging bolt in the status bar no longer goes missing. Restart after installing.

packs.title: Quick Share
packs.description: Quick Share finds and sends to nearby Galaxy devices (Wi-Fi Direct works without Samsung's Wi-Fi vendor parts). Restart after installing.

packs.title: Ruan Fixes 3.0
packs.description: Update notifications (every 6 h, daily, weekly or never), history of installed fixes, switches for USB debugging at boot and root for ADB shell; fixes the crash on open.

packs.title: Ruan Fixes 3.2
packs.description: New Add-ons section with optional extras, including a Wireless ADB switch. Restart after installing.

packs.title: SELinux log noise
packs.description: Silences four harmless SELinux denials (fonts, efs, em_version) logged at boot.

packs.title: USB debugging and adb root after reboot
packs.description: Starts USB debugging at boot without toggling it, and allows su from adb shell (deny Shell in Magisk to stop that).

addons.title: Android Auto
addons.description: Makes Android Auto work with your car over USB: system app with the USB permission, and no restart when hands-free Hey Google starts. Get Android Auto from Play Store too. Restart after installing.

addons.title: Samsung Flow
addons.description: Lets Samsung Flow open on this rooted tablet: root is hidden from Samsung Flow only. Restart after installing.
